latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of research-compiler skill.
- Implements a five-phase workflow for compiling and organizing scientific research outcomes, from intake and topic analysis to generating a finalized Word document.
- Offers structured frameworks in standard academic formats (research report, policy brief, technical standard, monograph, etc.).
- Features mandatory user confirmation at key workflow phases, especially for framework validation.
- Incorporates clear writing standards: concise, innovation-focused language, no filler text, and explicit labeling of innovations.
- Supports interactive, stepwise completion with progress reporting and requested user input at each stage.
